Sam K: Idea: stratified probe sampling + per-tenant probe budgets to catch regional regressions for low-volume regions.
Lee M: Today uniform probes miss tiny regions. How would stratified sampling look?
Sam K: Floor per-region + proportional tail. e.g., min 5 probes/min per-region, plus 0.01% tail.
Tanvi P: Need cost guardrails: cost_budget_per_hour and owner (tenant|platform). Also per-tenant opt-out for privacy.
Mike R: And define fallback types explicitly (region, model_variant, capacity). We should avoid automatic heavy-handed fallbacks.
Sam K: Plan: detection via probes -> update short-lived health signal. If signal > threshold AND budget allows -> schedule controlled fallback (rate-limited). Else emit alert/telemetry.
Lee M: Also EWMA smoothing + 95th pct latency window to prevent flip-flopping. Cap: max 3 fallbacks/hour per-tenant, decay 30m.
Tanvi P: Telemetry schema small: {probe_id, tenant, region, model_variant, latency_ms, ok}. Retention raw=1d, rollups=30d.
Mike R: Implementation sketch: probe-evaluator stage after route choose but before commit; async probe-accounting sidecar; action scheduler via control-plane API.
infra-bot: FYI: policy-sim run scheduled 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Sam K: Action items: Sam RFC draft, Tanvi telemetry + retention, Mike sidecar prototype, Lee add sim scenarios. I'll draft RFC today.
